svg.title: Tech stack, as a periodic table
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML5, CSS; Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind, Vite; Backend: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, WebSockets, Socket.io, JWT, Django, FastAPI; Data & queues: MongoDB, Postgres, Redis, Streams, BullMQ, Supabase; Ship & test: Docker, Compose, NGINX, AWS S3, Vercel, GH Actions, Git, Jest, Playwright, SonarQube, Puppeteer; Applied AI: Gemini, GPT-4o, RAG, Retell AI
